rule: Two copies of one multicoloured figure lie on black. One copy is intact and the other has some cells erased. Align the damaged copy with the intact one and mark each missing cell with 8, on 0. Output only the band of rows that contain missing cells, at the full figure width.
scope: Supported: random symmetric 8-connected layered figures 4..12 wide and 5..20 tall, with 3..5 colours from {1..7, 9}. The two copies are placed side by side or stacked, in either order, with a blank gap between them. Damage is a contiguous band of 1..4 rows with variable erasure density. Grid size varies up to 30x30. Not supported: asymmetric or freeform figures, damage in non-contiguous rows, background colours other than black, and copies that touch or overlap. Validation fixtures are rebuilt from explicit figure, position and erasure arguments. Explicit random figure sizes may extend to width 14 or height 24 when the requested canvas can fit the pair.
constraints: The intact figure is 8-connected, with no empty rows and with cells in its first and last columns, so its bounding box equals its stored size.
The two copies are separated by at least one blank row or column, so they never touch.
The damaged copy keeps at least half of the figure's cells (and at least 3), and it fits the template at exactly one translation.
The first and last rows of the damage band both contain erased cells, so the output height equals the band length.
Black (0) covers more than half of the input grid, so it is unambiguously the background colour. This fixes earlier failures on dense, narrow grids where a figure colour became the most common.
Every 8-connected component of the damaged copy is strictly smaller than the intact copy, so the intact copy is the unique largest object.
The output always contains at least one 8, so no sample is identity-like.
known_limitations: Figures are always left-right symmetric and built from rectangular layers, which is narrower than every possible ARC figure.
Damage is limited to one contiguous band of at most 4 rows.
Two copies must fit within 30x30. Tall figures can be placed side by side and wide figures can be stacked; default figure sizes are width 4..12 and height 5..20.
Ambiguity is excluded only for translations inside the damaged copy's bounding-box range. This matches how the alignment is defined for this task.
Bounded retry loops raise RuntimeError if no valid scene is found. This is extremely unlikely with default parameters.
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback
